decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal, by reason of its siting, scale and access arrangement, constitutes overdevelopment of the site, which would be overdominant and would be an unacceptable form of backland development which would harm the character of the locality and the amenities of adjoining residents. The proposal is contrary to Policies ENV1.1 (All new Development) and H.3.3 (Backland Development /Infill Development) and ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development) of the Council's adopted and revised Unitary Development Plans.


Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed development is likely to result in the loss of TPO trees on the site, which is likely to be detrimental to the general appearance of the streetscene to the detriment of the general visual amenities of the locality and would not conserve and enhance established habitats in the area. Their loss would be contrary to policy ENV.1.1 (All New Development), ENV1.9 (Trees and Community Woodlands), ENV4.1 (Protection of Open Space) and ENV1.10 (Tree Preservation Orders) of the Unitary Development Plan and policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-N.1.1 (Protection and Improvement of Local Open Space), ENV-N.2.7 (Trees and Community Woodlands) and ENV-N.2.8 (Tree Preservation Orders) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The proposal is likely to compromise traffic and pedestrian safety and be prejudicial to the free flow of traffic. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV.1.1 (All New Development) and T.3.6 (Road Safety) of the UDP and ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the Revised Deposit UDP.
description: Redevelopment of site for 8 dwellings consisting of 6 x 3  bed houses and 2 x 2 bed flats (Outline)
